title: Fix the board's held-width line, mode label and name from the operator's 0.13.0 re-test (seq 243)
description: Operator re-test of opum-ai/quest-cli#486 at 5705477b did NOT pass (relayed by opum-doc as seq 243, ODOC-OP-2026-10-03-74, recorded on opum-agent OPAG-1086/OPAG-1074). Three items on the #486 branch: (1) the DEC-154 rule 3 held-width line never rendered on the operator's client even though pluginPanes.dockColumns is kept -- the line waited on a draw after the ask, and a surface that keeps its width has no reason to repaint; it now renders on the ask's own draw when that draw is short of the ask, and a granting surface still clears it on the answering draw; (2) the full toggle label named the action ('Normal size') and read as the current state -- it now reads the current mode with the key as a hint ('Normal · z for full' / 'Full · z for normal'); (3) the operator's rename: pane title, tool lines and band read 'Quest', not 'Quest board'. The 0.13.0 bump and pair release stay HELD (OPAG-1086 AC3); do not merge, promote, tag or publish.
